pairs.target: dìèr shítiān shàngwǔ , běi gōng fāng yǒurén sònglái yìzhāng kǒuxìn .
pairs.english: On the twentieth morning someone brought a written message from the north workshop.
pairs.hanzi: 第二十天上午，北工坊有人送来一张口信。

pairs.target: zhǐ shàng shì nài lěi de zì , shuō xiàwǔ yǒu yuèjiè kè huílái jiǎng lù , tǎ wéi xiàkèhòu ruò yǒukōng , kěyǐ dào shài liào péng pángtīng .
pairs.english: Nerai's handwriting said a returning Outrider would give a route account that afternoon; Tavi could attend at the drying shed if free after class.
pairs.hanzi: 纸上是奈蕾的字，说下午有越界客回来讲路，塔维下课后若有空，可以到晒料棚旁听。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhǐ gěi yīwén kàn . yīwén dú dào " huílái " jiù táitóu , wèn shìbushì néng kànjiàn dài huílái de dōngxī .
pairs.english: He showed Iven the paper. At “returning,” Iven looked up and asked if they'd see what had been brought back.
pairs.hanzi: 他把纸给伊文看。伊文读到“回来”就抬头，问是不是能看见带回来的东西。

pairs.target: mǐlā zài lìng yìzhāng zhuōshàng huàtú , tīngjiàn tāmen shuōhuà , yě bǎ chǐzi fàngxià le .
pairs.english: Mira, drawing at another table, heard them and put her ruler down too.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉在另一张桌上画图，听见他们说话，也把尺子放下了。

pairs.target: xiàwǔ tāmen dào de shíhòu , péngwài yǐjīng zhàn le bùshǎo rén .
pairs.english: When they arrived that afternoon, a crowd was already outside the shed.
pairs.hanzi: 下午他们到的时候，棚外已经站了不少人。

pairs.target: yìmíng bān liào de gōngrén rènchū gāng xiàchē de nánrén , diūxià jiānshàng de kōng dài , zǒu guòqù gēn tā bào le yíxià , suíhòu chuí le chuí tā de bèi .
pairs.english: A materials worker recognized the man getting off a cart, dropped his empty sack, embraced him, then thumped his back.
pairs.hanzi: 一名搬料的工人认出刚下车的男人，丢下肩上的空袋，走过去跟他抱了一下，随后捶了捶他的背。

pairs.target: nà nánrén bèi chuí dé késou , xiào zhe tuīkāi tā . " hái huózhe ne , qīngdiǎn . "
pairs.english: The man coughed from the thumping and pushed him away laughing. “Still alive, you know. Gently.”
pairs.hanzi:
那男人被捶得咳嗽，笑着推开他。
“还活着呢，轻点。”

pairs.target: tā de wéijīn yuánxiān dàgài shì hóng de , rújīn shàichéng le qiǎnhèsè .
pairs.english: His scarf had probably been red once, now sun-faded to light brown.
pairs.hanzi: 他的围巾原先大概是红的，如今晒成了浅褐色。

pairs.target: bózi shàng yě guà zhe bái pái , pái biān módiào yìjiǎo .
pairs.english: He too wore a white tally, one corner worn away.
pairs.hanzi: 脖子上也挂着白牌，牌边磨掉一角。

pairs.target: liǎnggè xiǎoháizi zhuī zhe tā de bāo kàn , tā biàn chōuchū yìzhī chángzuǐ táo niǎo , qīngqīng yì chuī , niǎojiào le sānshēng , zuìhòu yìshēng xiàng rén dǎgé .
pairs.english: Two children followed his bag; he pulled out a long-beaked clay bird and blew softly. Three calls, the last like a hiccup.
pairs.hanzi: 两个小孩子追着他的包看，他便抽出一只长嘴陶鸟，轻轻一吹，鸟叫了三声，最后一声像人打嗝。

pairs.target: háizi men xiào dé dūn le xiàqù .
pairs.english: The children laughed themselves into a crouch.
pairs.hanzi: 孩子们笑得蹲了下去。

pairs.target: nài lěi zài pénglǐ zhāoshǒu , jiào tā xiān bǎ bāofàng hǎo .
pairs.english: Nerai beckoned from the shed, telling him to put his bag down first.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾在棚里招手，叫他先把包放好。

pairs.target: tā yìng le yìshēng , wānyāo shí míngxiǎn tíng le tíng , yòu bǎ yìzhī jiǎo wǎng wàicè fàng .
pairs.english: He answered, noticeably hesitated as he bent, then placed one foot farther out.
pairs.hanzi: 他应了一声，弯腰时明显停了停，又把一只脚往外侧放。

pairs.target: gōngrén wèn tuǐ zěnme le . tā shuō zǒu dé duō , bú àishì , réng bǎ bāo jiāogěi pángbiān de rén tíjìnqù .
pairs.english: The worker asked about his leg. He said too much walking, nothing serious, but let someone else carry the bag in.
pairs.hanzi: 工人问腿怎么了。他说走得多，不碍事，仍把包交给旁边的人提进去。

pairs.target: nánrén jiào cén dù . tā bú zhàn gāotái , bǎ yìzhāng yòng jiù de bù tú pù zài liǎngzhāng zhuōzi shàng , xiān yào shuǐ , hē le bànwǎn , cái wèn shuí bǎ zhuōzi bǎi chéng zhèyàng .
pairs.english: The man was Cendu. Rather than mount a platform, he spread a worn cloth map across two tables, asked for water, drank half a bowl, and asked who'd arranged the tables this way.
pairs.hanzi: 男人叫岑渡。他不站高台，把一张用旧的布图铺在两张桌子上，先要水，喝了半碗，才问谁把桌子摆成这样。

pairs.target: zhuō fèng zhèng chuānguò yízuò shān , huà zài shàngmiàn de lù duàn chéng le liǎngjié .
pairs.english: The gap ran through a mountain, splitting its painted road in two.
pairs.hanzi: 桌缝正穿过一座山，画在上面的路断成了两截。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bāngmáng jiāng zhuōzi tuī jìn . cén dù ànzhù dìtú , ràng tāmen bié bǎ zìjǐ de shǒuzhǐ jiájìnqù , suíhòu biàn cóng nàtiáo duàndiào de lù jiǎng qǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi helped push the tables together. Cendu held the map, warned them about their fingers, then began with that broken road.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维帮忙将桌子推近。岑渡按住地图，让他们别把自己的手指夹进去，随后便从那条断掉的路讲起。

pairs.target: tā zǒu de shì yán fēngdào . jīnnián yǒu yíduàn bèi zhǎngshuǐ chōngduàn , jiù lùbiāo hái zài , xīn zǒufǎ què yào ràoguò yípiàn báisè de qiǎntān .
pairs.english: He'd taken Saltwind Road. Floods had washed out a stretch this year; old markers remained, but the new path skirted a white shoal.
pairs.hanzi: 他走的是盐风道。今年有一段被涨水冲断，旧路标还在，新走法却要绕过一片白色的浅滩。

pairs.target: báitiān yuǎn kàn xiàng gān dì , jiǎo cǎi shàngqù , xiàmiàn de ní huì mànmàn mào shuǐ , bùnéng gǎnzhe zǒu .
pairs.english: From afar in daylight it looked dry, but underfoot the mud slowly seeped water. You couldn't hurry across.
pairs.hanzi: 白天远看像干地，脚踩上去，下面的泥会慢慢冒水，不能赶着走。

pairs.target: tóngháng de rén yòng chánggān xiān tàn , zài bǎ cǎi wěn de dìfāng yòng shéng chuàn qǐlái , huíchéng shōu shéng shí , yǒu yìgēn gān yǐjīng xié le .
pairs.english: His companions probed with poles, linking firm spots with cord; returning to collect it, they found one pole had tilted.
pairs.hanzi: 同行的人用长杆先探，再把踩稳的地方用绳串起来，回程收绳时，有一根杆已经斜了。

pairs.target: " nà dìfāng yèlǐ huì liàng ma ? " yígè xuéshēng wèn .
pairs.english: “Does it glow at night?” a student asked.
pairs.hanzi: “那地方夜里会亮吗？”一个学生问。

pairs.target: " búhuì . nǐ yàoshi juéde liàng , dàgài shì bǎ biérén dēng lǐ de yóu suàn chéng zìjǐ de le . "
pairs.english: “No. If it seems bright, you're probably counting someone else's lamp oil as your own.”
pairs.hanzi: “不会。你要是觉得亮，大概是把别人灯里的油算成自己的了。”

pairs.target: pénglǐ xiǎngqǐ xiàoshēng . cén dù yě xiào , tāochū xiédǐ gěi dàjiā kàn .
pairs.english: Laughter filled the shed. Cendu laughed too and brought out a sole to show everyone.
pairs.hanzi: 棚里响起笑声。岑渡也笑，掏出鞋底给大家看。

pairs.target: búshì zhěngzhī xié , zhǐshì yíkuài huànxiàlái de dǐ , biānyuán jiá zhe xìbái shā , xiàn kǒng mó dé xiàng bèi yáchǐ kěnguò .
pairs.english: Not a whole shoe, just a replaced sole, fine white sand in its edges and stitch holes worn as if gnawed by teeth.
pairs.hanzi: 不是整只鞋，只是一块换下来的底，边缘夹着细白砂，线孔磨得像被牙齿啃过。

pairs.target: mǐlā jiēguò láikàn , xiān mō xiàn kǒng , zài mō zhōngjiān méiyǒu móchuān de dìfāng . tǎ wéi děng tā kàn wán cái jiē .
pairs.english: Mira took it, feeling the stitch holes and the unworn center. Tavi waited until she was done before taking it.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉接过来看，先摸线孔，再摸中间没有磨穿的地方。塔维等她看完才接。

pairs.target: pígé hěn qīng , fàngzài zhǎngxīn , què ràng nà piàn méi jiàn guò de qiǎntān hūrán yǒu le fènliàng .
pairs.english: The leather was light in his palm, yet gave that unseen shoal a sudden weight.
pairs.hanzi: 皮革很轻，放在掌心，却让那片没见过的浅滩忽然有了分量。

pairs.target: yǒurén wèn tā zěnme bù zǒu jiù hékǒu de dù dào . cén dù de xiào dàn le xiē . " fēng zhe . "
pairs.english: Someone asked why he hadn't used the Old Rivermouth ferry route. Cendu's smile faded. “Closed.”
pairs.hanzi:
有人问他怎么不走旧河口的渡道。
岑渡的笑淡了些。“封着。”

pairs.target: nài lěi yìzhí zài zhuōbiān jì dōngxī , zhèshí táiqǐ tóu . " dōngàn de máo zuò hái méi huàn ? "
pairs.english: Nerai, taking notes by the table, looked up. “They haven't replaced the east-bank anchors yet?”
pairs.hanzi:
奈蕾一直在桌边记东西，这时抬起头。
“东岸的锚座还没换？”

pairs.target: " huàn le yígè . lìng yígè děng tiě . xiàmiàn de rén děng bùliǎo , zǒuyuǎnlù , yào yě gēnzhe zǒuyuǎnlù . "
pairs.english: “One. The other awaits iron. People down there can't wait. They take the long route, and so does the medicine.”
pairs.hanzi: “换了一个。另一个等铁。下面的人等不了，走远路，药也跟着走远路。”

pairs.target: tā bǎ yìxiǎo duàn wānlù zhǐchū lái , shuō tāmen yùjiàn guò liǎnggè sòngyào de rén , bèizhe xiāngzǐ guò pō , yuánběn bàntiān de lù , dé duō zǒu dào dìèrtiān .
pairs.english: He pointed to a small detour: they'd met two medicine carriers hauling boxes over a slope, a half-day journey stretched into the next day.
pairs.hanzi: 他把一小段弯路指出来，说他们遇见过两个送药的人，背着箱子过坡，原本半天的路，得多走到第二天。

pairs.target: tiānhēi shí yǒurén xiédài duàn le , zuòzài dìshàng yòng cǎoshéng jiē , pángbiān de rén bùkěn xiān zǒu .
pairs.english: At dusk one broke a shoelace and sat splicing it with grass cord; the other refused to go ahead.
pairs.hanzi: 天黑时有人鞋带断了，坐在地上用草绳接，旁边的人不肯先走。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ lù wù shì lǐ nà zhāng xiǎo wūdǐng hěnduō de tú .
pairs.english: Tavi remembered the collection's map full of tiny roofs.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起路物室里那张小屋顶很多的图。

pairs.target: " tíng dù de qiānzì lǐ yǒu wǒ de . " nài lěi shuō . cén dù diǎntóu , méiyǒu zhuāngzuò gāng zhīdào .
pairs.english: “My signature is on the closure,” Nerai said. Cendu nodded, not pretending this was news.
pairs.hanzi:
“停渡的签字里有我的。”奈蕾说。
岑渡点头，没有装作刚知道。

pairs.target: " suǒyǐ wǒ bǎ nà liǎnggè rén dehuà dài huílái .
pairs.english: “That's why I brought their words back.
pairs.hanzi: “所以我把那两个人的话带回来。

pairs.target: tāmen zhīdào máo zuò huài le , yě zhīdào nǐmen shuō chuán bùnéng mǎnzài .
pairs.english: They know the anchors are damaged and you say the boat can't run fully loaded.
pairs.hanzi: 他们知道锚座坏了，也知道你们说船不能满载。

pairs.target: dàn tāmen xiǎng wèn , wèishénme bùnéng xiān kāi yítàng zhī zǎirén de . "
pairs.english: But they want to know why there can't be a trip carrying only people for now.”
pairs.hanzi: 但他们想问，为什么不能先开一趟只载人的。”

pairs.target: péngzǐ lǐ ānjìng le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: The shed grew quieter.
pairs.hanzi: 棚子里安静了一点。

pairs.target: wàimiàn yǒurén jùmù tou , jù dàotóu shí , yúxià nà yìxiǎo jiédiào zài dìshàng , shēngyīn géwài qīngchǔ .
pairs.english: Someone was sawing outside; when the cut finished, the little offcut fell with an unusually clear sound.
pairs.hanzi: 外面有人锯木头，锯到头时，余下那一小截掉在地上，声音格外清楚。

pairs.target: nài lěi bǎ bǐ fàngxià . " wǒ shì guò nàgēn jiù suǒ . búshì shǎozhuāng jǐxiāng jiù wěn dé zhù . "
pairs.english: Nerai put down her pen. “I tested that old cable. A few fewer boxes wouldn't make it safe.”
pairs.hanzi:
奈蕾把笔放下。
“我试过那根旧索。不是少装几箱就稳得住。”

pairs.target: " nà línshí de ne ? " " wǒ líkāi shí , dāying sòng qù de hái méi dào . " " wǒ huílái shí yě méi dào . "
pairs.english: “And the temporary one?” “When I left, the promised replacement hadn't arrived.” “It still hadn't when I came back.”
pairs.hanzi:
“那临时的呢？”
“我离开时，答应送去的还没到。”
“我回来时也没到。”

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén kànzhe tóng yíkuài bù , shuí yě méi mǎshàng shuōhuà .
pairs.english: Both looked at the same cloth; neither spoke at once.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人看着同一块布，谁也没马上说话。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yuányǐwéi nài lěi huì zhǐchū lìng yígè dìfāng , gàosù dàjiā lù qíshí néng zǒu , huòshì cén dù jìcuò le shénme .
pairs.english: Tavi had expected Nerai to point elsewhere and explain the route was passable, or Cendu had misremembered something.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维原以为奈蕾会指出另一个地方，告诉大家路其实能走，或是岑渡记错了什么。

pairs.target: tā què zhī wèn nà liǎnggè sòngyào de rén jiào shénme , zhù zài nǎ yíduàn .
pairs.english: Instead she only asked the carriers' names and where they lived.
pairs.hanzi: 她却只问那两个送药的人叫什么，住在哪一段。

pairs.target: cén dù bào le míngzì , ràng tā bǎ qízhōng yígè zì gǎiguòlái .
pairs.english: Cendu gave the names and corrected one character she wrote.
pairs.hanzi: 岑渡报了名字，让她把其中一个字改过来。

pairs.target: hòulái háiyǒu rén wèn yán fēngdào de shuǐ hé liáng , yě yǒurén bǎ táo niǎo chuán zhe chuī , chuī bù xiǎng , nào chū jǐshēng duǎn xiào .
pairs.english: Later people asked about water and food on Saltwind Road, while others passed the clay bird around, failing to whistle and provoking little laughs.
pairs.hanzi: 后来还有人问盐风道的水和粮，也有人把陶鸟传着吹，吹不响，闹出几声短笑。

pairs.target: cén dù zuòxià lái , mànmàn róu zhe jiǎohuái , huà bǐ gāngcái shǎo le xiē .
pairs.english: Cendu sat, slowly rubbing his ankle, quieter than before.
pairs.hanzi: 岑渡坐下来，慢慢揉着脚踝，话比刚才少了些。

pairs.target: sàn de shíhòu , tǎ wéi liúzài zhuōbiān bāng zhe shōu tú .
pairs.english: Afterward Tavi stayed to help put away the map.
pairs.hanzi: 散的时候，塔维留在桌边帮着收图。

pairs.target: nài lěi bǎ xiě mǎn de zhǐjiá jìn cèzǐ , jiàn tā méi zǒu , wèn shìbushì yǒu huà .
pairs.english: Nerai slipped the filled page into her notebook and, seeing him still there, asked if he had something to say.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾把写满的纸夹进册子，见他没走，问是不是有话。

pairs.target: tā diǎntóu , yòu kàn le kàn hái zuòzài pángbiān de cén dù . " wǒ bù zhīdào cóng nǎjù wèn . "
pairs.english: He nodded and glanced at Cendu still sitting nearby. “I don't know where to begin.”
pairs.hanzi:
他点头，又看了看还坐在旁边的岑渡。
“我不知道从哪句问。”

pairs.target: nài lěi méiyǒu tì tā xuǎn .
pairs.english: Nerai didn't choose for him.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾没有替他选。

pairs.target: tā shuō zìjǐ yào xiān bǎ zhè jǐtiáo xiāoxī sòng qù , míngtiān xiàwǔ zài xuégōng xiàcéng de huò péng biān děng tā , nàlǐ néng zuò , yě bù dānwù kàn chē .
pairs.english: She said she first had to deliver these reports, and would meet him tomorrow afternoon by the school's lower freight shed, where they could sit and watch the carts.
pairs.hanzi: 她说自己要先把这几条消息送去，明天下午在学宫下层的货棚边等他，那里能坐，也不耽误看车。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dāying le . zǒuchū péngzǐ shí , nà liǎnggè xiǎoháizi yǐjīng bù zhuī bāo le , yígè zhàn zài cén dù pángbiān , tì tā ná zhe kōng shuǐ wǎn , xiàng yě lǐngdào le yíjiàn bùnéng mǎhǔ de chāishì .
pairs.english: Tavi agreed. Outside, the children had stopped chasing the bag. One stood beside Cendu holding his empty bowl, as if entrusted with a task requiring care.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维答应了。走出棚子时，那两个小孩子已经不追包了，一个站在岑渡旁边，替他拿着空水碗，像也领到了一件不能马虎的差事。
